name: 2024 Active + REE-way redispatch, rules instead of REE hours
note: As 2024 Active + REE-way redispatch, real-time reserve, with phase I from rules only: no REE-named units (Aboño 2, Besós 5, Cartagena 1, Bahía de Bizkaia, San Roque 2, Aceca 4; dropped 9 Nov) and voltage-zone needs from the load rule on the model own demand instead of REE 2024 hours. Real time rerun with fix A (a unit is started for reserve only if its bus can export its minimum load). Branch redispatch-realism 476d316 (markets and phase I bbb436e), 366 days, weeks in order. Redispatch cost per phase on REE measure (P.O. 14.4).

info.commit_message: Fix A: reserve starts only where the bus can export the minimum load; real-time replay on a saved in-chain year (replay reproduces 4 Apr 2024: status 24/24 same; with fix A 24/24 solved)
